blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators Risa Hontiveros and Pia Cayetano locked horns anew on Monday over an alleged attempt to close the period of amendments to the proposed expanded anti-online child sexual abuse bill despite a list of revisions that the latter still wanted to introduce.
